summary: Write the integral over Z as an integral over the stack (convolution) of the indicator, swap the integrals and recognise the inner product of Bessel vectors (unipotentMass_mul_inner_besselVector) in the upper pairing.

steps.claim: The integrand y ↦ 1_Z(y)·phase(g, yxy⁻¹) is integrable (bounded by 1 on the finite-measure set Z).
steps.lean:
have I := (integrableOn_of_bounded (h.groupMeasure_ne_top Z.2.2) (by fun_prop) (.of_forall fun z ↦
    norm_phase_le_one (g := F.g) (y := z * x * z⁻¹))).integrable_indicator Z.isOpen.measurableSet

steps.claim: Write it as an integral of an indicator against the stack measure,
steps.lean: rw [← integral_indicator Z.isOpen.measurableSet, groupMeasure, stackMeasure_zero_eq] at *

steps.claim: decompose the convolution, swap the integrals and use the inner-product formula; this is |upperPairing(…)|·unipotentMass(F).
steps.lean:
simp [↓(integral_mconv I).trans (integral_integral_swap (I.comp_measurable measurable_mul)),
    ↓← unipotentMass_mul_inner_besselVector Z, upperPairing, mul_comm, ← ofReal_norm, -toReal_prod]
